title: Start your Seedance prompt with a strict format block specifying…
content:
Start your Seedance prompt with a strict format block specifying duration/model/style and hard negatives (e.g., 30s / Seedance 2.5 / 24fps cinematic motion / no dialogue / no text / no titles) to lock output constraints.

Use two references with distinct roles: set Reference 1 as an absolute anchor for exact character identity and environment, and Reference 2 as a storyboard/action blueprint for framing and beat progression.

Explicitly enforce identity consistency by listing immutable traits (face/eyes/hair/age/proportions/wardrobe/watch) and repeating “exactly the same man throughout” to prevent drift across shots.

Prevent continuity errors by writing prop/food state machines (raw egg → cracked → cooked → flipped → plated; coffee machine off → activated → pours into same mug) and explicitly forbidding duplication/teleporting/premature completion.

Control camera behavior shot-by-shot with measurable instructions (camera height, distance, travel amount, and move type like dolly push-in 1–1.5m, lateral truck 40–60cm, pull-out from 1.5–2m to 3–4m).

Direct focus and lens behavior with explicit rack-focus targets and depth-of-field notes (e.g., move focus from face → hand → fingertip → button; close shallow-focus macro for pours).

Build pacing by mapping timestamps to micro-scenes and specifying one “hero beat” only (e.g., egg flip as the single heightened anime moment) while banning wild orbits/FPV/whip pans to keep motion coherent.

Specify gradual lighting/color progression over time (cool morning shadows → balanced → honey-gold warmth → golden rim light) and forbid sudden grading/time-lapse to maintain realism.

Improve realism by prompting concrete physics constraints (gravity, viscosity, steam, refraction, plausible toast pop height, believable egg flip height) and banning impossible food physics.

Add naturalistic motion quality by instructing acceleration/deceleration on all camera moves, maintaining cinematic motion blur, and allowing only slight high-speed emphasis without freezing.

If generating with audio, synchronize SFX/music beats to on-screen actions (CLICK/CRACK/CUT/SNAP/POP/POUR/SIP) and briefly duck ambience at the hero apex, then restore on landing.

es.content:
Comienza tu prompt de Seedance con un bloque de formato estricto que especifique duración/modelo/estilo y negativos duros (por ejemplo, 30s / Seedance 2.5 / movimiento cinematográfico a 24fps / sin diálogo / sin texto / sin títulos) para fijar las restricciones de salida.

Usa dos referencias con roles distintos: establece la Referencia 1 como un ancla absoluta para la identidad exacta del personaje y el entorno, y la Referencia 2 como un storyboard/blueprint de acción para el encuadre y la progresión de los beats.

Impón explícitamente la consistencia de identidad enumerando rasgos inmutables (cara/ojos/pelo/edad/proporciones/vestuario/reloj) y repitiendo “exactly the same man throughout” para evitar desviaciones entre planos.

Evita errores de continuidad escribiendo máquinas de estado para props/comida (huevo crudo → roto → cocinado → volteado → emplatado; cafetera apagada → activada → vierte en la misma taza) y prohibiendo explícitamente la duplicación/teletransporte/completado prematuro.

Controla el comportamiento de la cámara plano por plano con instrucciones medibles (altura de cámara, distancia, cantidad de desplazamiento y tipo de movimiento como dolly push-in de 1–1.5 m, truck lateral de 40–60 cm, pull-out de 1.5–2 m a 3–4 m).

Dirige el enfoque y el comportamiento del lente con objetivos explícitos de rack focus y notas de profundidad de campo (por ejemplo, mover el enfoque de rostro → mano → punta del dedo → botón; macro de enfoque superficial y cerrado para vertidos).

Construye el ritmo mapeando timestamps a micro-escenas y especificando solo un “hero beat” (por ejemplo, el volteo del huevo como el único momento anime intensificado) mientras prohíbes órbitas salvajes/FPV/whip pans para mantener el movimiento coherente.

Especifica una progresión gradual de iluminación/color a lo largo del tiempo (sombras frías de la mañana → equilibrado → calidez miel-dorada → luz de contorno dorada) y prohíbe el grading repentino/time-lapse para mantener el realismo.

Mejora el realismo indicando restricciones físicas concretas (gravedad, viscosidad, vapor, refracción, altura plausible del salto de la tostada, altura creíble del volteo del huevo) y prohibiendo la física imposible de los alimentos.

Añade calidad de movimiento naturalista instruyendo aceleración/desaceleración en todos los movimientos de cámara, manteniendo motion blur cinematográfico y permitiendo solo un ligero énfasis de alta velocidad sin congelación.

Si generas con audio, sincroniza los beats de SFX/música con las acciones en pantalla (CLICK/CRACK/CUT/SNAP/POP/POUR/SIP) y baja brevemente el ambiente en el clímax heroico, luego restáuralo al aterrizar.

fr.content:
Commencez votre prompt Seedance par un bloc de format strict précisant la durée/le modèle/le style et des négatifs stricts (par ex. 30s / Seedance 2.5 / 24fps cinematic motion / no dialogue / no text / no titles) afin de verrouiller les contraintes de sortie.

Utilisez deux références aux rôles distincts : définissez la Reference 1 comme un ancrage absolu pour l’identité exacte du personnage et l’environnement, et la Reference 2 comme un storyboard/plan d’action pour le cadrage et la progression des temps forts.

Imposez explicitement la cohérence d’identité en listant les traits immuables (face/eyes/hair/age/proportions/wardrobe/watch) et en répétant “exactly the same man throughout” pour éviter toute dérive d’une prise à l’autre.

Prévenez les erreurs de continuité en rédigeant des machines d’état pour les accessoires/aliments (raw egg → cracked → cooked → flipped → plated; coffee machine off → activated → pours into same mug) et en interdisant explicitement la duplication/le téléportage/l’achèvement prématuré.

Contrôlez le comportement de la caméra plan par plan avec des instructions mesurables (hauteur de caméra, distance, amplitude du déplacement et type de mouvement comme dolly push-in 1–1.5m, lateral truck 40–60cm, pull-out from 1.5–2m to 3–4m).

Dirigez la mise au point et le comportement de l’objectif avec des cibles explicites de rack-focus et des indications de profondeur de champ (par ex. move focus from face → hand → fingertip → button; close shallow-focus macro for pours).

Construisez le rythme en reliant les timestamps à des micro-scènes et en ne spécifiant qu’un seul “hero beat” (par ex. egg flip as the single heightened anime moment) tout en interdisant les orbits sauvages/FPV/whip pans afin de garder un mouvement cohérent.

Précisez une progression graduelle de l’éclairage/couleur dans le temps (cool morning shadows → balanced → honey-gold warmth → golden rim light) et interdisez tout grading/time-lapse soudain afin de préserver le réalisme.

Améliorez le réalisme en imposant des contraintes physiques concrètes (gravity, viscosity, steam, refraction, plausible toast pop height, believable egg flip height) et en bannissant toute physique alimentaire impossible.

Ajoutez une qualité de mouvement naturaliste en demandant une accélération/décélération sur tous les mouvements de caméra, en conservant un cinematic motion blur, et en n’autorisant qu’une légère emphase haute vitesse sans figer l’image.

Si vous générez avec de l’audio, synchronisez les beats SFX/music avec les actions à l’écran (CLICK/CRACK/CUT/SNAP/POP/POUR/SIP) et baissez brièvement l’ambiance au moment du hero apex, puis rétablissez-la à l’atterrissage.

ja.content:
Seedance の prompt は、duration / model / style と hard negatives（例: 30s / Seedance 2.5 / 24fps cinematic motion / no dialogue / no text / no titles）を明記した strict format block で始め、出力の制約を固定します。

役割の異なる 2 つの reference を使います。Reference 1 は、キャラクターの正確な identity と environment を固定する絶対的な anchor とし、Reference 2 は framing と beat progression のための storyboard / action blueprint として設定します。

identity の一貫性は、変更不可の特徴（face / eyes / hair / age / proportions / wardrobe / watch）を列挙し、さらに “exactly the same man throughout” を繰り返して、ショット間の drift を防ぎます。

continuity error を防ぐために、prop / food の state machine を記述します（raw egg → cracked → cooked → flipped → plated; coffee machine off → activated → pours into same mug）。また、重複、teleporting、premature completion を明確に禁止します。

camera の挙動は shot ごとに、測定可能な指示で制御します（camera height、distance、travel amount、dolly push-in 1–1.5m、lateral truck 40–60cm、pull-out from 1.5–2m to 3–4m などの move type）。

focus と lens の挙動は、明示的な rack-focus の対象と depth-of-field の注記で指示します（例: face → hand → fingertip → button に focus を移す、pour では close shallow-focus macro を使う）。

pacing は timestamp を micro-scenes に割り当てて構成し、hero beat は 1 つだけにします（例: egg flip を唯一の強調された anime moment にする）。一方で、wild orbit / FPV / whip pan は禁止し、motion の一貫性を保ちます。

lighting / color の変化は時間経過に沿って段階的に指定します（cool morning shadows → balanced → honey-gold warmth → golden rim light）。また、突然の grading / time-lapse は禁じて、realism を維持します。

realism を高めるには、具体的な physics 制約を prompt します（gravity、viscosity、steam、refraction、妥当な toast の pop height、信じられる egg flip height など）。そして、あり得ない food physics は禁止します。

motion の質は、すべての camera move に acceleration / deceleration を指示し、cinematic motion blur を維持しつつ、わずかな high-speed emphasis のみを許可して、freeze は避けます。

audio を生成する場合は、SFX / music の beat を画面上のアクションに同期させます（CLICK / CRACK / CUT / SNAP / POP / POUR / SIP）。また、hero apex では ambience を短く duck し、landing で元に戻します。

ko.content:
Seedance prompt는 duration/model/style과 hard negatives를 명시하는 엄격한 format block으로 시작하세요. 예: 30s / Seedance 2.5 / 24fps cinematic motion / no dialogue / no text / no titles. 이렇게 해야 출력 제약이 고정됩니다.

서로 다른 역할을 가진 두 개의 reference를 사용하세요: Reference 1은 정확한 캐릭터 정체성과 환경을 위한 절대적 anchor로 설정하고, Reference 2는 framing과 beat progression을 위한 storyboard/action blueprint로 설정합니다.

얼굴/눈/머리카락/나이/비율/의상/시계 같은 변경 불가능한 특징을 나열하고, “exactly the same man throughout”를 반복해서 shot 간 드리프트를 방지하며 정체성 일관성을 명시적으로 강제하세요.

prop/food state machine을 작성해 continuity error를 막으세요(예: raw egg → cracked → cooked → flipped → plated; coffee machine off → activated → pours into same mug). 또한 duplication/teleporting/premature completion을 명시적으로 금지하세요.

camera behavior는 shot별로 측정 가능한 지시사항으로 제어하세요(카메라 높이, 거리, 이동량, 그리고 dolly push-in 1–1.5m, lateral truck 40–60cm, pull-out from 1.5–2m to 3–4m 같은 move type).

focus와 lens behavior는 명시적인 rack-focus 대상과 depth-of-field 노트로 지시하세요(예: face → hand → fingertip → button으로 초점을 이동; pours에는 close shallow-focus macro 사용).

timestamp를 micro-scene에 매핑하고 하나의 “hero beat”만 지정해 pacing을 구성하세요(예: egg flip을 유일한 고조된 anime moment로 설정). 동시에 wild orbits/FPV/whip pans는 금지해 motion이 일관되게 유지되도록 하세요.

시간에 따른 lighting/color progression을 점진적으로 지정하고(차가운 아침 그림자 → 균형 잡힌 톤 → honey-gold warmth → golden rim light), 사실감을 유지하기 위해 sudden grading/time-lapse는 금지하세요.

중력, 점도, 증기, 굴절, 그럴듯한 toast pop height, 믿을 만한 egg flip height 같은 구체적인 물리 제약을 prompt에 넣어 현실감을 높이고, 불가능한 food physics는 금지하세요.

모든 camera move에 acceleration/deceleration을 지시하고, cinematic motion blur를 유지하며, 약간의 high-speed emphasis만 허용하고 freezing은 금지해 자연스러운 motion quality를 강화하세요.

audio를 생성할 경우, SFX/music beat를 화면상의 동작과 동기화하세요(CLICK/CRACK/CUT/SNAP/POP/POUR/SIP). 그리고 hero apex에서는 ambience를 잠깐 duck한 뒤, landing 시 다시 복원하세요.

pt.content:
Comece seu prompt do Seedance com um bloco de formato rígido especificando duração/modelo/estilo e negativos fortes (por exemplo, 30s / Seedance 2.5 / 24fps cinematic motion / no dialogue / no text / no titles) para travar as restrições de saída.

Use duas referências com papéis distintos: defina a Reference 1 como uma âncora absoluta para a identidade exata do personagem e do ambiente, e a Reference 2 como um storyboard/blueprint de ação para enquadramento e progressão de beats.

Imponha explicitamente a consistência de identidade listando traços imutáveis (face/eyes/hair/age/proportions/wardrobe/watch) e repetindo “exactly the same man throughout” para evitar deriva entre os planos.

Evite erros de continuidade escrevendo state machines de props/comida (raw egg → cracked → cooked → flipped → plated; coffee machine off → activated → pours into same mug) e proibindo explicitamente duplicação/teletransporte/conclusão prematura.

Controle o comportamento da câmera plano a plano com instruções mensuráveis (altura da câmera, distância, quantidade de deslocamento e tipo de movimento como dolly push-in 1–1.5m, lateral truck 40–60cm, pull-out from 1.5–2m to 3–4m).

Direcione o foco e o comportamento da lente com alvos explícitos de rack-focus e observações de depth of field (por exemplo, mover o foco de face → hand → fingertip → button; close shallow-focus macro for pours).

Construa o ritmo mapeando timestamps para micro-scenes e especificando apenas um “hero beat” (por exemplo, o flip do ovo como o único momento anime de maior impacto) enquanto proíbe orbits/FPV/whip pans exagerados para manter o movimento coerente.

Especifique a progressão gradual de iluminação/cor ao longo do tempo (cool morning shadows → balanced → honey-gold warmth → golden rim light) e proíba grading/time-lapse súbitos para manter o realismo.

Melhore o realismo solicitando restrições físicas concretas (gravity, viscosity, steam, refraction, plausible toast pop height, believable egg flip height) e proibindo física impossível de alimentos.

Adicione qualidade de movimento naturalista instruindo aceleração/desaceleração em todos os movimentos de câmera, mantendo cinematic motion blur e permitindo apenas uma leve ênfase de alta velocidade sem congelamento.

Se estiver gerando com áudio, sincronize SFX/music beats com as ações na tela (CLICK/CRACK/CUT/SNAP/POP/POUR/SIP) e reduza brevemente o ambience no ápice do hero beat, depois restaure no landing.

zh.content:
以严格的格式块开始你的 Seedance prompt，明确指定时长/模型/风格以及硬性负面限制（例如：30s / Seedance 2.5 / 24fps cinematic motion / no dialogue / no text / no titles），以锁定输出约束。

使用两个具有不同职责的参考图：将 Reference 1 设为绝对锚点，用于精确锁定角色身份和环境；将 Reference 2 设为 storyboard/action blueprint，用于构图和节奏推进。

通过列出不可变特征（脸/眼睛/头发/年龄/比例/服装/手表）并重复 “exactly the same man throughout” 来显式强化身份一致性，防止跨镜头漂移。

通过编写道具/食物状态机来防止连续性错误（raw egg → cracked → cooked → flipped → plated；coffee machine off → activated → pours into same mug），并明确禁止重复/瞬移/过早完成。

用可测量的指令逐镜头控制 camera 行为（camera height、distance、travel amount，以及 move type，如 dolly push-in 1–1.5m、lateral truck 40–60cm、pull-out from 1.5–2m to 3–4m）。

通过明确的 rack-focus 目标和景深说明来指导对焦与镜头行为（例如：将焦点从 face → hand → fingertip → button；pour 场景使用 close shallow-focus macro）。

通过将时间戳映射到微场景，并只指定一个 “hero beat”（例如：egg flip 作为唯一的高光 anime moment）来构建节奏，同时禁止 wild orbits/FPV/whip pans，以保持运动连贯。

指定随时间推进的渐进式 lighting/color 变化（cool morning shadows → balanced → honey-gold warmth → golden rim light），并禁止 sudden grading/time-lapse，以维持真实感。

通过提示具体的物理约束来提升真实感（gravity、viscosity、steam、refraction、合理的 toast pop height、可信的 egg flip height），并禁止不可能的食物物理表现。

通过要求所有 camera move 都具备加速/减速过程、保持 cinematic motion blur，并且只允许轻微的高速强调而不冻结画面，来加入自然的 motion quality。

如果生成时包含音频，则将 SFX/music 节拍与画面动作同步（CLICK/CRACK/CUT/SNAP/POP/POUR/SIP），并在 hero apex 短暂压低环境音，随后在落点恢复。
